newsitem.title: USA: Parkway buys Atlanta building for $11.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Parkway buys Atlanta building for $11.5 mln.

text.p: Parkway Properties Inc said Monday it had bought an office building in Atlanta for $11.5 million.
The real estate investment trust said in a statement its purchase was funded with advances under bank lines of credit.
It was also funded by the assumption of a $6.9 million first mortgage at 8.08 percent interest, with payments based on a 15-year amortization period and maturity date of August 15, 2006, it said.
Parkway said Lakewood II, a 118,750 net rentable square foot, five-story office building with an attached 406-space three level parking deck, was 100-percent leased to nine tenants.

"The acquisition of Lakewood increases Parkway's portfolio in Atlanta to 476,000 square feet, which furthers Parkway's goal of achieving a critical mass of at least 500,000 square feet in Atlanta," it said.
